description:
Cast Pyretic Ritual by paying {R}.
With Pyretic Ritual on the stack, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {R}{R}, copying Pyretic Ritual and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Pyretic Ritual copy, adding {R}{R}{R}.
